visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair, wearing a black button-down shirt, sits in a room with a bed and a warm lamp in the background. He holds a large, square black box with the text "Galaxy Z Fold7" toward the camera, smiling and moving his mouth. (2) A close-up shot shows his fingers peeling a black security sticker off the edge of the box. The lighting is warm and focused on his hands and the box. (3) He opens the box lid to reveal a blue folding smartphone nestled inside. A digital sparkle graphic is superimposed on the phone momentarily. (4) He lifts the phone, displaying its extremely thin side profile to the camera. Yellow text reading "4.2mm" appears on the screen. He rotates the device to show its metallic blue finish and camera lenses. (5) He unfolds the phone, revealing a large square internal display. The screen shows the "SAMSUNG Galaxy" startup logo. He points his finger toward the screen while maintaining a pleasant expression. (6) He demonstrates the folding mechanism multiple times, holding the center of the screen close to the lens to highlight the smoothness of the hinge area. (7) He speaks directly to the camera while holding the unfolded device in front of him, looking satisfied.
